literal: Aniccam flower / stem / she removed not / she wore / to the waist / good / will not sound / drums
translation: She wore Aniccam flowers without removing their stems; for her delicate waist, auspicious drums will no longer sound.
modern: அனிச்ச மலர்களின் காம்புகளை நீக்காமல் அவள் சூடிக்கொண்டாள்; அந்த பாரத்தால் ஒடியப் போகும் அவளது இடைக்காக இனி மங்கலமான பறைகள் ஒலிக்கமாட்டா.
explanation: The lover exaggerates the extreme delicacy of his beloved's waist. He notes that she has worn delicate Aniccam flowers without first pinching off their stems. Because her waist is so fragile, even the minuscule added weight of the stems will cause it to snap, meaning she will not survive and only inauspicious funeral drums will be beaten for her.
